name: i18n-next-rs
description: Workspace root: delegates to the guest-js package (crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next), the docs site and the playgrounds.

scripts.docs:dev: pnpm -C docs install && pnpm -C docs dev
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm -C docs install && pnpm -C docs generate
scripts.playground:tauri: pnpm -C crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next build && pnpm -C examples/tauri-app tauri dev
scripts.playground:web: node -e "console.error('examples/leptos-app is added in M9'); process.exit(1)"
